description: The global 'int limit = 10' has no semicolon and is directly followed by 'int main(void) {'.
injected_faults: line 3: missing ';' at the end of the global declaration 'int limit = 10'
notes: The next line starts with the keyword 'int', so the parser notices there; by convention the root is the line of the global. Cascade: main may be swallowed into the declaration, and 'limit' / 'main' symptoms follow. gcc: expected ',' or ';' before 'int'.
